note: Byte caps on hook stdout that Claude Code injects into context. SessionStart used to dump the whole MEMORY.md; UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PostToolUse guards can each add kilobytes per tool call. The launcher (global/guards/run.mjs) enforces these: stdout beyond the cap for the hook's event is truncated with a '[truncated: N bytes over budget]' note. A guard that BLOCKS (exit 2) is never truncated — its verdict is security-critical. stderr is never truncated (it stays in the transcript, not context). Override everything with the HOOK_TOKEN_BUDGET env var (a JSON object shaped like 'events', or the integer default).
